template.p: The Dentist Practice industry package helps dental practices manage enquiries, practitioner bookings, financial proposals, reception payments, supplies, laboratory orders, equipment service and administrative paperwork with standard Odoo apps.

Open Practice Desk for Patient Journey, Diary and Reception POS, together with the patient, financial, supplies, practice operations and team workspaces. For a worked day at a practice, open Willow Dental - Practice Guide in the Knowledge app.

Review company details, currency, taxes, invoicing and payment journals. Set the practice's fees on the service products or assign a practice pricelist to the relevant patients and Reception POS. With demo data, Willow Dental Fees supplies the example rates for the sample patients and register.

Create staff users and matching employee records, assign app access and review Dental Practice Working Hours. Assign each practitioner to the relevant appointment types, enable employee schedules, and review timezone, availability, duration, booking notice and cancellation settings. Publish the patient-facing appointment types once their practitioners are assigned. Share the practitioners' calendars with reception.

The appointments schedule users: a dentist or hygienist. Employee working hours and approved absence in the Time Off app contribute to availability. Configure staff absence and approval policies before use, and review pending requests before confirming changes to the diary.

The starting booking horizons are 90 days for examinations and treatment, 180 days for hygiene and seven days for urgent consultations. Routine visits use 24 hours' booking and cancellation notice; urgent consultations use one hour. Edit each appointment type to match the practice's actual arrangements. These settings do not prescribe recall dates.

In Team → Activity Roles, an administrator can add actual reception staff to Dental Reception. The administrator is the initial member; the Willow demonstration also includes Jamie. Reception plans assign tasks to this role. Members open Reception → Reception Tasks and claim the work by assigning themselves. Existing individually assigned tasks remain with their owners.
Use Practice Desk → Patient Journey from the first enquiry through the agreed next step. Its stages are New enquiry, Appointment, Treatment proposal, Follow-up and Next step agreed.
The CRM app and Practice Desk open this same journey. Appointment attendance stays on the booking and proposal preparation/sending stays on the Sales quotation.

ol.li: Record contact details, source, medium, referral and the responsible reception owner. Contact the person and agree a time before creating a booking.
Apply the Patients contact tag when registered, create the practitioner appointment, and move the journey to Appointment. Record attendance on the booking.
When a cost proposal is needed, continue on the same opportunity through Treatment proposal and Follow-up. Keep the quotation and next activity linked to the journey.

Record Next step agreed once reception has confirmed the outcome and the next arrangement. This is the won stage for the administrative journey. Use Lost and a suitable reason for an enquiry or proposal that closes without an agreed next step.

template.p: Staff advance stages after completing the work. Stage changes do not create a booking, send correspondence or record a payment.
template.h2: Receive website enquiries and manage the diary
template.p: Use the opportunity's existing Tags field for visit purpose: First examination, Hygiene visit, Urgent consultation and Treatment discussion or session.

Native opportunity properties record Preferred contact, Preferred appointment times, Available at short notice and Decision blocker. Use them for reception preferences and information still to discuss. The existing default team holds the shared property definition; there is one Patient Journey. Booking, quotation and payment states remain on their native documents.

The Willow Dental website presents Home, Our care, Our practice and Fees and first visit. New patients collects a name and email, with optional phone, preferred times and an administrative message. The standard form creates an opportunity for reception to review. An enquiry submission does not reserve an appointment or send a patient reply.

The Book a visit link opens the native appointment page. In Practice Desk → Diary, review the selected practitioner, patient, time and duration. The four appointment types cover a new-patient examination, hygiene visit, urgent consultation and treatment session.

Use Check in, No show and cancellation controls to record the appointment outcome. Checked-In records attendance. Configure email delivery for the native one-day booking reminder and review any separate communication services the practice chooses.

Reception → Today opens the native booking list with today's visits in time order. Favorites narrow it to booked, checked in or no show. Dates follow the signed-in user's timezone. The full diary remains available separately.

Short-notice Callbacks lists open opportunities whose Available at short notice property is Yes. Group by visit-purpose tags, review preferred contact and availability, and offer a suitable practitioner slot. Update the preference when circumstances change; the queue does not reserve an appointment.
template.h2: Prepare a proposal and arrange follow-up
template.p: Send appointment booking link opens an email draft for the published first-examination type. To send a link that ties a booking to an opportunity, copy the invitation from that opportunity's calendar sharing controls into the draft. Send patient booking link opens the published appointment list from Contacts. Review the recipient and appointment before sending either email.

Dental booking invitation schedules a booking-email task on the plan date and a callback two days later. Staff preview and send the email; the plan does not send it automatically or reserve an appointment.

Other email activities pair each message with its source record. On a patient contact, schedule Send patient registration email or Send patient post-visit email. On a Sales quotation, use Send treatment estimate follow-up for its proposal portal link. On a posted patient invoice, use Send patient payment reminder for its remaining balance and invoice link. Open the scheduled activity and choose Preview to review the recipient and message before sending. Respect the agreed contact method, review the current outcome, and complete unnecessary tasks.

The reusable activity types are Patient enquiry callback, Patient visit preparation, Treatment estimate discussion, Patient post-visit check-in, Arrange the next visit and Reception payment handoff. They are available across records that support activities. Real appointments retain Odoo's native meeting activity and calendar booking.

Create the quotation from the opportunity in the Sales app. Choose Dental first-visit estimate for an examination or Dental hygiene estimate for a hygiene visit. Dental treatment estimate contains an agreed-services section for staff to fill in, without adding an examination charge. Review quantities, fees and taxes, then share the standard quotation link with the patient.

Launch activity plans manually from the opportunity or patient contact. Choose the reference date, review the reception role and generated deadlines, then select Schedule. Dental enquiry callbacks supports new enquiries; Dental estimate decision supports a shared proposal; and Dental post-visit reception follow-up supports the reception handoff.

On a calendar booking, launch Dental visit handoff with the visit date: preparation one day before, checkout on the day, check-in one day after, and a next-visit review three days after. On an invoice, launch Dental reception collection with its due date: review the balance on that date and follow up two days later if still unpaid. Review the reception assignment, opening-day and practitioner-agreed timing before scheduling. Plans do not launch themselves on stage changes. Suggested next activity types are prompts for staff, not automatic bookings or clinical communications. Complete or remove remaining activities after the outcome.

For a later recall, schedule a separate Call on the date agreed with the patient and practitioner. Review deadlines outside opening days. Staff select and review the corresponding email activity when email is the agreed channel; an activity plan does not send it automatically.
Open Practice Desk → Reception POS, select Reception and open its session. Review opening cash and the configured payment methods. Select the patient before collecting a charge.

ul.li: Existing quotation or uninvoiced Sales order: select Quotation / Order, choose the document and use Settle the order. For an agreed deposit, choose Apply a down payment (percentage) or Apply a down payment (fixed amount). The native Sales link keeps collection attached to the original order.

Existing invoice: review a draft invoice and select Confirm first. In the customer's POS menu, select Settle invoices and choose the posted invoice. This collects the existing receivable; adding its service tile again would create another sale.
New charge without an order or invoice: add the agreed service once, review the fee and tax, and complete the POS sale. Request an invoice through the standard POS flow when the patient needs one.

template.p: Cash records cash received. Card records a card payment completed through the practice's external payment process; no payment terminal is connected by this setup. Existing-invoice settlement accepts partial collection, uses the customer's accounting balance and requires accounting access. Its screen does not accept change or a Customer Account payment.

The Invoicing app remains available for invoice review, bank payments and reconciliation. Its invoice buttons are Confirm and Pay. Review the day's receipts and cash count before closing the POS session. Quotation acceptance, invoice posting, collection and reconciliation are separate business steps.

Purchase supplies in the configured boxes or packs and count them in individual stock units. Review the supplier, specification, price, pack size and lead time. Count stock in Dental Supplies using the Inventory app's Operations → Adjustments → Physical Inventory screen. Review differences before selecting Apply.

The location has a weekly count cycle. Manually launch Weekly supply check on a product to assign counting, expiration review and ordering review. Check open RFQs and receipts before requesting more stock. Replenishment rules use Manual; set minimum and maximum quantities for the practice's demand.

Review the RFQ, confirm the purchase order and validate the delivered quantities through its receipt. The putaway rule stores supplies in Dental Supplies. For tracked materials, record the manufacturer's lot and labeled expiration date, and configure appropriate product alert offsets. Staff record consumption or count differences; booking an appointment does not deduct supplies.

In Receipts, use Favorites for Supplies - overdue receipts or Supplies - open backorders. The Purchases list also has Supplies - late deliveries. Batches and Expiry starts with stock on hand whose alert has arrived or expiration is within 30 days; clear that favorite to see all dental-supply batches. Dates and quantities come from native stock records.
Match the supplier's draft bill against the order and receipt before confirming it. Use the standard supplier-payment and reconciliation process after review.
template.h2: Coordinate laboratory work and equipment service
template.p: Use Supplies and Lab → Lab Orders for laboratory services. Keep the administrative case reference, supplier, fee, due date and responsible person on the purchase order. Schedule a follow-up, confirm delivery with reception and update the received service quantity before reviewing the bill.
Lab Orders Favorites include Lab - outstanding work and Lab - overdue work. Update received service quantities after the lab confirms delivery, so these queues reflect the actual outstanding work.

In the Maintenance app, keep equipment serial numbers, supplier details, responsible staff and service reports with each asset. Set recurring preventive requests from the approved equipment schedule. Mark the request state Done after completion to generate its next occurrence; moving its Kanban stage alone does not do this.

The Documents app separates Patient Administration, Financial Proposals, Signed Administration, Equipment Records and Administrative Templates. Use native sharing to grant appropriate staff access. Upload activities route registration documents and supplier service reports into their relevant folders.

Practice Operations → Awaiting Signatures lists outstanding sent requests. Outstanding Uploads lists unfulfilled document requests. These queues follow the native request states and existing access permissions.

The Sign app includes Patient registration and Financial proposal acknowledgement forms, branded Willow Dental when demo data is loaded. Review and adapt forms for the practice before sending a request. Proposal acknowledgement records receipt; acceptance follows the separate Sales quotation process.

This package covers practice administration. Clinical consent, tooth charting, prescriptions, imaging, laboratory instructions, sterilization cycle records and insurance claims stay within the practice's approved clinical workflows.
